display.title: Episode 181: The Island of Treasures (Erev Rosh Chodesh Tammuz)
display.summary_short: A shipwrecked man is crowned king of an island but spends its whole treasury there: Uncle Yossi's parable about this world as the hallway to the World to Come, plus a mezuzah quiz.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Erev Rosh Chodesh Tammuz 5745. Uncle Yossi recalls the blessing of the new month said on Shabbos Mevarchim, ending with the prayer for Moshiach, and leads the Hakochainik march. After a sponsor message, a yeshiva boy recites the Shema and then the Mishnah in Bava Metzia about which lost objects a finder may keep, a lesson in honesty. Story time follows Pirkei Avos, chapter 4, read that Shabbos: this world is like a hallway before the banquet hall of the World to Come. In the parable, the only survivor of a shipwreck washes up on an island, where the people crown him king and give him the keys to the royal treasury. He spends it all beautifying the island, only to learn the secret: when the next castaway arrives he must leave as poor as he came. Too late, he wishes he had sent treasure home. The island is this world, the treasures are mitzvos, and the Torah is the key. On Mitzvah Time a young listener answers phone questions about the mezuzah and wins a prize.
display.lesson: This world is the hallway to the World to Come; use your time here to 'send ahead' treasures of Torah and mitzvos.
